Recently there was a controversy involving mods of a subverse wanting to ban certain offensive words from being used. Some argued that the mods should be allowed to curate their sub however they please, and others argued that the sub was generic enough that it should conform to the site-rules only. I think the obvious compromise here is to allow subverse owners to mark their subverse as being either curated or permissive. If a subverse is marked as permissive, the moderators would be obligated to only enforce site-wide rules and if a subverse is marked curated, the moderators can do as the please. The running-cost of this is that it requires admin-intervention to enforce the permissive rule.
Simple compromise for allowing mods to curate their subs and enforcing free-speech.
